content:
========================================
KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS
========================================

--- NAVIGATION ---

ArrowLeft / z / b   Previous chapter
ArrowRight / m / ;  Next chapter
n                   Next chapter
e                   Open Ref prompt (Bible reference)
y                   Previous chapter
t                   Go to chapter 1 of current book
q                   Previous book
w                   Next book
[                   Previous verse
]                   Next verse

--- SCROLLING ---

Space / PageDown    Page down
p / + / = / ArrowDown  Page down
o / - / ArrowUp / PageUp  Page up
x                   Scroll down one line

--- MODALS & OVERLAYS ---

`  (backtick)       Open Book Navigator
                    Type a book code (e.g. Ge, He, Ps)
                    or  He 2  to jump to Hebrews 2
                    or  2  to jump to chapter 2
                    of the current book

o                   Toggle Outline modal
y                   Toggle YouTube modal
w                   Toggle Words modal
s                   Toggle Soaking worship audio
u                   Toggle reading ruler

Escape              Close open modal (no action if none open)

--- READING & TTS ---

r                   Read highlighted text in English
j                   Read highlighted text in first visible
                    TTS tooltip language (set in gear ⚙)

Cmd/Ctrl+C          Speak top visible verse in pane 2
  (no text selected)
' (apostrophe)      Speak current book & chapter
\ (backslash)       Speak selected verse number

Verse TTS tooltip languages (select text to see tooltip):
  A — Cantonese (zh-HK)
  M — Mandarin (zh-CN)
  E — English (en-US)
  P — Spanish (es-ES)
  K — Korean (ko-KR)
  F — French (fr-FR)
  G — Greek (el-GR)
  H — Hebrew (he-IL)
  Toggle visibility: gear ⚙ in tooltip OR settings gear ⚙

--- DISPLAY ---

d                   Toggle dark mode
1 – 9               Select pane 2 translation by index

--- OTHER ---

v                   ch:v clipboard navigation
/                   Toggle Read-to-end mode
i                   Click Load Prompt button
g                   Cycle Firebase saved positions


========================================
BOOK NAVIGATOR  (`)
========================================

Press ` to open, type a code, press Enter.
Prefix matching: typing 'hebrews' resolves via 'he'.
Codes are case-insensitive.

--- OLD TESTAMENT ---

  Ge  Genesis        Ex   Exodus         L    Leviticus
  Nu  Numbers        De   Deuteronomy    Jos  Joshua
  Judg Judges        Ru   Ruth           1S   1 Samuel
  2S  2 Samuel       1K   1 Kings        2K   2 Kings
  1C  1 Chronicles   2C   2 Chronicles   Ezr  Ezra
  Ne  Nehemiah       Es   Esther         Jo   Job
  Ps  Psalms         Pr   Proverbs       E    Ecclesiastes
  S   Song of Songs  I    Isaiah         Je   Jeremiah
  La  Lamentations   Ez   Ezekiel        D    Daniel
  Ho  Hosea          Joe  Joel           Am   Amos
  O   Obadiah        Jon  Jonah          Mi   Micah
  N   Nahum          H    Habakkuk       Zep  Zephaniah
  Ha  Haggai         Z    Zechariah      Mal  Malachi

--- NEW TESTAMENT ---

  Mt  Matthew        Mar  Mark           Lu   Luke
  Joh John           Ac   Acts           Ro   Romans
  1Co 1 Corinthians  2Co  2 Corinthians  G    Galatians
  Ep  Ephesians      Phili Philippians   C    Colossians
  1Th 1 Thess.       2Th  2 Thess.       1Ti  1 Timothy
  2Ti 2 Timothy      T    Titus          P    Philemon
  He  Hebrews        J    James          1P   1 Peter
  2P  2 Peter        1J   1 John         2J   2 John
  3J  3 John         Jude Jude           R    Revelation

Disambiguation examples:
  h → Habakkuk   ha → Haggai   he → Hebrews   ho → Hosea
  j → James      jo → Job      joh → John     jon → Jonah
  m → Malachi    mar → Mark    mt → Matthew   mi → Micah
  p → Philemon   phili → Philippians
  r → Revelation ro → Romans   ru → Ruth
  z → Zechariah  zep → Zephaniah


========================================
ch:v BUTTON (green)
========================================

Reads clipboard for chapter:verse (e.g. "3:2") and
navigates to that verse in the current book.

  1. Copy a reference like  3:2  in another app
  2. Press v (or click the ch:v button)
  3. App navigates to that verse

Clicking pane 2 also triggers ch:v automatically.


========================================
P2 Only (P2:ON) BUTTON — orange
========================================

Hides pane 1 so pane 2 fills full width.
Click again to restore split view.


========================================
search-.com BUTTON — purple
========================================

Opens search-niv.netlify.app for NIV word search.
